line.comment: * Task 1329.
* Expanded 2.2: The old approach did not account for those infectees or underequipped/unequipped infectees.
* This script has been improved to handle the matryoshka effect and potential player exploits regarding equipment or nesting.
* Infection deadlines persist across ship copying and task restarts.
* Generate the deadline only for new infections.
* Warning-name cycle remains task-local.
* ===== Incubation =====
* Mature at the saved deadline or when an early takeover is triggered.
* Restart updated scripts without resetting the infection deadline.
* Broadcast takeover overrides the remaining incubation period.
* The ship may have been destroyed while waiting.
* ZH 1.10: OCV-built ships mature immediately when attacking Xenon or OCV.
* Non-OCV infectees must mature normally.
* Expanded 2.2: Display the remaining incubation time on detected infectees.
* Refresh once per minute; undetected infections remain hidden.
* ===== Infection matured. =====
* Preserve maturity independently of the asynchronous resolver.
* Expanded 2.2: Show that the detected infection has matured.
* Defer conversion of the current player ship.
* Resolve other eligible infectees immediately.
* The player may have changed the deferred ship's sector.
* Resolve this ship and all other eligible infectees in its sector.
* Generate and store an absolute infection deadline exactly once.
* Add-Ons 1.9.3: Insurance reduces timing variance by 85% on Hard and 70% on Insane.
* Never happens on easy/normal (negative events cannot occur with insurance policy); just in case.
* Expanded 2.2: Removed obsolete RNG workaround. Randomize timing using the ship quality offset.
* Add-Ons 1.3: Duration reduced by 30% on insane.
* Minimum incubation time: 600 seconds.
* Expanded 2.2: Debug overrides timer. 5-minute incubation.
* Store the deadline permanently on this ship.
* Resolve the sector containing the ship, including docked ships.
* Expanded 2.2: Compact countdown for detected infections.
* Round up to the next whole minute.
* Use shared time formatter.
